notes: A gather-and-bank loop with trees shared server-wide is Simulation's extraction family, and nothing else is in scope — the author explicitly excluded trading, shops, combat and quests — so there is no second genre. I took the Mining & Extraction preset for its resource-shared and collectible-nodes, which describe this exactly (a pine forest the whole server draws from on a 30-second respawn, with the wood as the extractable node), but substituted world-open for the preset's world-underground because nothing here goes below the surface, which also keeps the build off P2 and P3; path-circulation replaces the preset's hauling roads since the dirt path is walked, not driven. The town center comes in as settlement-density for the small medieval hamlet plus social-hub for the square players spawn in and return to, with the wording bent to note it has no shops yet, and the explicitly requested uneven ground is terrain-relief, which is what adds tiered. Deciding without a user: town and forest sit on one continuous surface a few seconds apart, so one map and no P4; no building is enterable, so no P3; and the twenty-plus pine trees, tree health, cooldowns, tool animations, UI and DataStore work are recorded here because they are systems rather than layout picks.
